messages:
Aisha: Postmortem follow-up: morning spike impacted large-batch throughput. I summarized actions and an SLO proposal.

Carlos: paste actions plz, missed standup.

Aisha: Actions: 1) Autoscaler debounce + cap (Carlos) 2) KV-shard prewarm on rotation (Ravi) 3) New composite throughput SLO + dashboard (Tess) 4) Runbook updates for GPU preemptions (Carlos)

Ravi: I can prototype prewarm hook. Est: 3d prototype, 1wk staging validation.

Carlos: Autoscaler: increase debounce from 30s->90s, add scale-in cooldown 5m, and a hard burst cap. Will bench and PR this week.

Tess: SLO draft: route=generate-large composite: 95% of rolling 5m windows >= 120 req/min AND p95 latency < 250ms. Alert if pct_windows_below_120 > 2% over 30m.

Aisha: Also change error budget review cadence to weekly for throughput-critical routes until stable.

Carlos: Agree on rolling windows. Will add runbook links to alert so oncall has steps: check autoscaler logs -> prewarm runs -> GPU preempts.

slo-bot: Draft SLO created: generate-large_composite_v1. Reviewers: eng-oncall, eng-sre, product. Use /slo-approve to sign off.

incident-bot: Reminder: close action items in postmortem doc. Open items older than 21 days will trigger reminders.

Tess: I'll wire dashboards this afternoon and post link. Will also add panels: throughput rolling 1m, p95 latency 5m, pct_5m_windows_below_120.

Carlos: PR for autoscaler posted for initial review.

Ravi: Will post staging canary results here once run completes.

Aisha: Meeting scheduled Mon 09:30 to review metrics. Please add PR links to the postmortem so incident-bot stops nagging.

Carlos: ack. closing thread for now.
